_notes: floor/rolling MUST be npm-installable versions: matrix.sh `swap`s them into node_modules from the registry. Labels like '1.7.0-eager' or an unpublished '1.5.0' will break the gate before it measures anything. floor=1.3.0 is the current `latest` stable anchor; rolling=1.7.0-preview.2 is the immediate predecessor of this candidate (the `preview` dist-tag). Tolerances calibrated against measured self-noise (npm run calibrate: frame.avg <=3.4%, frame.p99 up to 14%). frame.avg is the tight stable anchor (5% rolling, safely above its ~3% noise). p99 gates sit above the 14% p99 self-noise so they only fire on gross tail regressions. If the gate reports NO EVIDENCE (spread > maxSpreadPct), the host was noisy -- quiesce and recapture; do NOT raise tolerances to force a pass.
